K_rule: K = F: every search candidate is trained for the full final budget, so no short-budget proxy (and no proxy-fidelity gate) is involved.
unchanged_from_v0_3: simulation config, traces, JAR and P01-P06 evidence
80 candidate slots x 2 model repeats, NSGA-II and random search
F = 102,400; protocol A/B reuse; B = ceil(C/512)*512
hypothesis registry: 3 primary (Holm) + 60 secondary (Holm), crossed bootstrap, exploratory rules
test split sealed until the v0.4 lock verifies
rationale: The registered v0.3 fidelity gate failed at every K (best median Spearman 0.476 at 30,720), i.e. short-budget rankings do not predict final-budget rankings. Searching at K = F removes that proxy. It does not remove seed noise: in the pilot, two independent seeds ranked the 8 weights with median Spearman 0.095 at F, while the best weight (vertex2) was consistent across all 3 pilot outers. Power for RQ1-RQ3 may therefore be limited; null results are reported in full.

v0.3.status: gate failed at all K; M3 no-go
